kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتألمن (form IIq)
# نَتَأَلْمَنُ (nataʔalmanu) /na.ta.ʔal.ma.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
# نَتَأَلْمَنَ (nataʔalmana) /na.ta.ʔal.ma.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
# نَتَأَلْمَنْ (nataʔalman) /na.ta.ʔal.man/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَأَلْمَنَ (taʔalmana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
